main_text.l: Ad horam autem primam à prandio, venerunt in carcerem primus
& secundus praefes, Chassagneus, Longa, & plures alij consiliarij.
Hic tum M. Aymondus sermonem habere coepit de Coena, hanc suam
fidem dicens: Quod scilicet, quotiescunque Christiani in vera unita-

l.i: te ac concordia conveniunt, docentes eandem omnes doctrinam, atque
in fide non ficta & spe certa sumunt panem, revera corporis & san-
guinis Christi participes fiant: ibique in eam sententiam citavit locum
Pauli I.Corint. XI, summa profecto cum gratia Scripturam exponens.

main_text.l: Ac dum ipsis loqueretur, semel alta voce exclamavit: Verba quae

panem & vinum oblatum in Coena: iterumque varios Scripturae locos

page.notes: The strikethrough: the words "nempe Christianos communicare corpori & sanguini Iesu Christi, quicunque fide recipiunt panem & vinum oblatum in Coena: iterumque" are struck through in ink on the scan. They are transcribed above as printed. The word "prosua" may be two words, "pro sua", with the space unclear. The marginal note "Isai.53. b.4." is partly unclear. The word "setio" reads as a long-s word, probably "sētio" or "sentio". The bottom edge of the page is cut off by the scan after the last line, so a partial line there is not transcribed.
